editorial: As much as we loved Rapa Nui and regretted not seeing Atacama, Patagonia is Chile’s crown jewel. And so, it would be prudent to visit during the warmer months (November to February) that are best for hiking.
We visited in October, which is springtime (September and October) and experienced pleasant weather in Santiago and Rapa Nui and some cold winds in Patagonia.
Winters (June to August) in Patagonia can be harsh, so you’d want to avoid this window.
